focus: 以泥沙守恆與監測辨識養灘的短期重塑和長期功能~Distinguish nourishment reshaping and long-term function through sediment accounting and monitoring

units.anchor: 養灘幾何與方量~Nourishment geometry and volume
units.title: 養灘幾何與方量~Nourishment geometry and volume
units.mechanism: 養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。矩形示意適合練習尺寸核對，真實海灘有斜坡與沿岸變化，需要逐剖面積分；初始灘寬也不保證風浪重塑後仍維持相同位置。 假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。 ~Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum. Delivered loose volume need not equal completed profile volume. A rectangular illustration helps check dimensions, but a real beach varies alongshore and across its slopes and requires section integration; initial width does not guarantee the same shoreline after wave-driven redistribution. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design.
units.verify: 在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。核對計量採原狀、鬆方或完成方，與運輸票據比較差異時保留孔隙和含水定義。~Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area. State whether quantities are in-situ, loose or completed volumes; retain porosity and moisture definitions when comparing survey totals with delivery records.
units.failure: 用車船鬆方直接代替完成灘體會把孔隙變化誤認為流失，缺少近岸水下剖面又會漏掉重分布砂。表面變寬不能單獨證明整個活動剖面已增加足夠儲砂。~Substituting delivered loose volume for completed beach volume confuses porosity change with loss. Missing submerged sections conceal redistributed sand, and a wider dry beach alone does not establish added storage across the active profile.
units.misconception: 施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。~The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season.
units.practice: 在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。核對計量採原狀、鬆方或完成方，與運輸票據比較差異時保留孔隙和含水定義。~Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area. State whether quantities are in-situ, loose or completed volumes; retain porosity and moisture definitions when comparing survey totals with delivery records.

units.anchor: 固體量與孔隙~Solid quantity and porosity
units.title: 固體量與孔隙~Solid quantity and porosity
units.mechanism: 養灘材料以固體顆粒量追蹤比較穩定，因為排水及壓密會改變外觀體積。乾質量換算需用顆粒密度而非濕容重，孔隙率亦須對應相同材料狀態；黏土團塊或貝殼會使單一密度近似失準，不能只憑船艙刻度結算泥沙收支。 假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。 ~Tracking solid grains helps distinguish material movement from drainage and compaction. Dry-mass conversion requires grain density rather than wet bulk density, with porosity defined for the same condition. Clay aggregates or shells can invalidate a single-density approximation, so hopper readings alone cannot close the sediment balance. Assume bulk volume10000m³, porosity0.40 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume bulk volume10000m³, porosity0.40 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water.
units.verify: 取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。把含水造成的重量變化和真正乾固體輸入分開，再檢查換算是否使用同一孔隙定義。~Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates. Separate water-weight changes from dry-solid input, and verify that every conversion uses the same definition of void space.
units.failure: 若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。不同批次含貝殼與細料時，沿用同一密度也可能製造不存在的收支缺口。~Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. Variable shell and fine content also makes a single borrowed density create an artificial deficit in the sediment budget.
units.misconception: 孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。~Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains.
units.practice: 取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。把含水造成的重量變化和真正乾固體輸入分開，再檢查換算是否使用同一孔隙定義。~Collect representative wet and dry samples, measuring moisture, grain density and bulk volume with locations and replicates. Separate water-weight changes from dry-solid input, and verify that every conversion uses the same definition of void space.

units.title: 粒徑相容性~Grain-size compatibility
units.mechanism: 借砂與原灘的中值粒徑可作第一層比較，但單一比值會隱藏級配、細料與顆粒形狀。不同粒群在波流中有不同沉降及搬運行為，較粗不必然在所有位置都更好；材料選擇還牽涉生態、灘坡和使用功能，需把各種證據並列。 假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。 ~Median size offers an initial comparison between borrow material and native sand, but one ratio hides grading, fines and particle shape. Different fractions settle and move differently under waves and currents. Coarser is not universally better, and selection also involves ecology, beach slope and intended use, requiring several complementary observations. Assume borrow D50=0.45mm and native D50=0.30mm. Their ratio is1.50; this alone establishes neither grading compatibility nor retention.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume borrow D50=0.45mm and native D50=0.30mm. Their ratio is1.50; this alone establishes neither grading compatibility nor retention.
units.verify: 將完整累積粒徑曲線並排，核對細料比例及取樣深度，避免只比中值。另記顆粒形狀、污染篩查與原灘季節變化，說明哪些物理或環境條件仍沒有代表性樣本。~Compare complete cumulative size curves, checking fines and sampling depth rather than only medians. Record particle shape, contaminant screening and seasonal native variability, identifying physical or environmental conditions for which representative field samples remain unavailable.
units.failure: 中值相同的兩批材料可能有完全不同的細料尾端，入水後一批產生長距離濁羽、另一批迅速沉降。只使用中值配比會錯估輸運與環境影響。~Two materials with identical medians may have very different fine tails; one generates a long plume while another settles quickly. Median-only matching therefore misrepresents both transport behavior and environmental consequences of placement.
units.misconception: 借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。~A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention.
units.practice: 將完整累積粒徑曲線並排，核對細料比例及取樣深度，避免只比中值。另記顆粒形狀、污染篩查與原灘季節變化，說明哪些物理或環境條件仍沒有代表性樣本。~Compare complete cumulative size curves, checking fines and sampling depth rather than only medians. Record particle shape, contaminant screening and seasonal native variability, identifying physical or environmental conditions for which representative field samples remain unavailable.

units.title: 活動剖面平移~Active-profile translation
units.mechanism: 把新增體積分配到假想活動剖面，可估計岸線平移的量級，但須先指定陸側高度與閉合水深。實際剖面會調整坡度並沿岸交換泥沙，閉合深度也受觀測期影響；平行平移只是一項幾何假設，不能將計算結果直接當成施工後岸線預測。 假設V=30000m³、沿岸長1000m、閉合深5m、陸側高2m，Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m；只限平行平移。 ~Distributing added volume across an assumed active profile gives a shoreline-displacement scale after specifying berm elevation and closure depth. Real profiles change slope and exchange sand alongshore, and closure depth depends on the observation period. Parallel translation is a geometric assumption, not a direct forecast of the actual post-construction beach shoreline. Assume V=30000m³, length1000m, closure depth5m and berm elevation2m. Parallel translation Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設V=30000m³、沿岸長1000m、閉合深5m、陸側高2m，Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m；只限平行平移。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume V=30000m³, length1000m, closure depth5m and berm elevation2m. Parallel translation Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m.
units.verify: 清楚標出剖面上下界和零高程，測試閉合深度不同時結果如何改變。用多季節水陸聯測剖面比較實際重塑，將沿岸漏失、坡形變化及測量誤差另列，不強迫資料吻合平移。~Mark profile limits and the vertical origin and test alternative closure depths. Compare multiple seasonal land-and-water surveys with the translation estimate, listing alongshore exchange, slope adjustment and measurement error rather than forcing the measured observations to fit.
units.failure: 把短期觀測不到變化的位置當成永久閉合深度，會高估岸線移動量；若近岸形成砂壩，材料仍在剖面內卻未出現在乾灘，使僅看岸線的判讀失真。~Treating a temporarily inactive depth as permanent closure can overstate shoreline movement. A nearshore bar may retain sand within the profile without widening the dry beach, misleading interpretations based on shoreline position alone.
units.misconception: 新增砂量除以灘長就能得到岸線前進的長度。~Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement.
units.practice: 清楚標出剖面上下界和零高程，測試閉合深度不同時結果如何改變。用多季節水陸聯測剖面比較實際重塑，將沿岸漏失、坡形變化及測量誤差另列，不強迫資料吻合平移。~Mark profile limits and the vertical origin and test alternative closure depths. Compare multiple seasonal land-and-water surveys with the translation estimate, listing alongshore exchange, slope adjustment and measurement error rather than forcing the measured observations to fit.

units.anchor: 沿岸泥沙收支~Alongshore sediment budget
units.title: 沿岸泥沙收支~Alongshore sediment budget
units.mechanism: 養灘區不是封閉容器，上下游輸砂差和跨岸交換共同改變儲砂。年度平均通量只適合所定義邊界與時段，暴風、港口阻砂及補砂事件可能打破平穩假設；應先確認輸入輸出各自的符號與單位，再討論需要維持的功能。 假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。 ~A nourishment reach is not a sealed container: alongshore flux differences and cross-shore exchange alter storage. Annual mean transport applies only to its specified boundaries and period. Storms, harbor interception and new placements can break stationarity, so signs and units must be established before discussing the intended coastal function to maintain. Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³.
units.verify: 在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。用獨立地形差量測試收支殘差，並把不同年份的風暴條件分開而不是只看長期平均。~Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways. Test budget residuals against independent elevation change and distinguish storm conditions between years rather than relying exclusively on a single long-term average.
units.failure: 同一砂量在兩個相鄰邊界重複計入會製造假盈餘，忽略跨岸砂壩交換則容易將季節儲存誤認永久流失。平穩外推也可能低估一次大事件的主導作用。~Double-counting sediment at adjacent boundaries creates an artificial surplus, while omitted cross-shore bar exchange makes seasonal storage resemble permanent loss. Stationary extrapolation can also miss the dominant influence of one large event.
units.misconception: 年平均泥沙赤字能保證每個月份都按同一速度退縮。~An annual sediment deficit guarantees an identical retreat rate every month.
units.practice: 在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。用獨立地形差量測試收支殘差，並把不同年份的風暴條件分開而不是只看長期平均。~Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways. Test budget residuals against independent elevation change and distinguish storm conditions between years rather than relying exclusively on a single long-term average.

units.anchor: 壓密與體積變化~Compaction and apparent volume loss
units.title: 壓密與體積變化~Compaction and apparent volume loss
units.mechanism: 同一乾固體量隨孔隙改變而呈現不同鬆方，養灘完工後地形下降不一定全是輸砂。需要把粒子輸出和孔隙水排除分開，同時注意級配分選會改變密實狀態；幾何測量提供外形，而固體收支才幫助辨認真正材料流失。 假設固體體積18000m³保持不變，孔隙率0.40時鬆方30000m³，降到0.35後V=18000/0.65=27692.3m³。 ~An unchanged quantity of solids occupies different bulk volumes as porosity changes, so post-placement lowering need not be entirely sediment transport. Separate particle export from drainage while recognizing that sorting changes packing. Geometry describes the exterior, whereas solid accounting helps identify actual offshore material loss. Assume unchanged solid volume18000m³. Bulk volume is30000m³ at porosity0.40 and27692.3m³ at porosity0.35, using V=Vs/(1−n).
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固體體積18000m³保持不變，孔隙率0.40時鬆方30000m³，降到0.35後V=18000/0.65=27692.3m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unchanged solid volume18000m³. Bulk volume is30000m³ at porosity0.40 and27692.3m³ at porosity0.35, using V=Vs/(1−n).
units.verify: 在相同範圍重測剖面並取密度樣本，將沉降量與孔隙改變能解釋的部分比較。保持乾固體定義一致，另查波流輸出證據，避免以任意壓密係數吸收所有量測差異。~Resurvey identical limits and sample density, comparing lowering with the portion explained by changing void space. Maintain a consistent dry-solid definition and inspect transport evidence separately rather than automatically absorbing every discrepancy into an arbitrary compaction factor.
units.failure: 濕砂表面下降若全部記成侵蝕，會高估維護需求；反過來把真正沖失都稱為壓密，則隱藏砂源不足。缺少密度與地形的共同證據無法區分兩種機制。~Calling all surface lowering erosion overstates maintenance needs, while labeling real export as compaction conceals inadequate supply. Without paired density and terrain evidence, the two mechanisms cannot reliably be distinguished in the completed beach.
units.misconception: 乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。~Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume.
units.practice: 在相同範圍重測剖面並取密度樣本，將沉降量與孔隙改變能解釋的部分比較。保持乾固體定義一致，另查波流輸出證據，避免以任意壓密係數吸收所有量測差異。~Resurvey identical limits and sample density, comparing lowering with the portion explained by changing void space. Maintain a consistent dry-solid definition and inspect transport evidence separately rather than automatically absorbing every discrepancy into an arbitrary compaction factor.

units.anchor: 暴風後剖面恢復~Post-storm profile recovery
units.title: 暴風後剖面恢復~Post-storm profile recovery
units.mechanism: 暴風可把上灘砂移到水下，後續較緩波況再將部分材料送回，因此恢復率需明示控制範圍與基準。相同乾灘體積恢復不代表粒群或灘形完全恢復，觀測期間亦會左右比例；應同時追蹤總量、位置與功能而非只追一個百分比。 假設固定調查範圍暴風減少20000m³，之後回增8000m³，仍缺12000m³、恢復率40%；未證明其餘砂永久外移。 ~Storms can move upper-beach sand offshore and calmer waves return part of it. A recovery fraction therefore requires explicit survey limits and a reference state. Restored dry-beach volume does not imply identical grading or shape, and the observation interval affects the fraction; track quantity, geographical position and function together. Assume a fixed survey area loses20000m³ in a storm and later gains8000m³. Deficit remains12000m³ and recovery is40%, without proving permanent export.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固定調查範圍暴風減少20000m³，之後回增8000m³，仍缺12000m³、恢復率40%；未證明其餘砂永久外移。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a fixed survey area loses20000m³ in a storm and later gains8000m³. Deficit remains12000m³ and recovery is40%, without proving permanent export.
units.verify: 保留暴風前、後及恢復期的同範圍剖面，分別記上灘與近岸砂壩的量。核對水位和季節條件，將未觀測水深列為未知，而不把那部分材料自動列為損失。~Retain matching pre-storm, post-storm and recovery surveys, separating upper-beach and nearshore-bar storage. Check water level and season, marking unobserved depths as unknown rather than automatically treating their material as lost from the system.
units.failure: 恢復期只量乾灘會忽略仍在近岸的庫存，調查邊界移動又可能創造假恢復。若依單一百分比決定補砂，可能反覆搬入材料而沒有處理真正輸砂路徑。~Dry-beach-only monitoring misses nearshore storage, and moving survey boundaries can create artificial recovery. Basing replenishment on one percentage can repeatedly add material without addressing the actual sediment pathways responsible for observed change.
units.misconception: 暴風後尚未回到乾灘的砂都已永久離開海岸系統。~All sand not yet returned to the dry beach has permanently left the coast.
units.practice: 保留暴風前、後及恢復期的同範圍剖面，分別記上灘與近岸砂壩的量。核對水位和季節條件，將未觀測水深列為未知，而不把那部分材料自動列為損失。~Retain matching pre-storm, post-storm and recovery surveys, separating upper-beach and nearshore-bar storage. Check water level and season, marking unobserved depths as unknown rather than automatically treating their material as lost from the system.

units.anchor: 高程偏差與方量~Elevation bias and volume uncertainty
units.title: 高程偏差與方量~Elevation bias and volume uncertainty
units.mechanism: 大面積相減對共同高程偏差非常敏感，許多測點並不能消除同一基準造成的系統誤差。兩期獨立的整面偏差可用不確定度傳播估計量級，但不能與逐格獨立噪音混為一談；這項區別決定應改善控制點還是加密量測。 假設面積100000m²，兩期各有獨立整面高程標準不確定度0.03m，σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³；不是逐格獨立誤差。 ~Large-area differencing is sensitive to coherent vertical bias, and many points do not remove an error shared by one datum. Independent whole-survey offsets can be propagated to estimate uncertainty, but they must not be confused with independent cell noise; that distinction determines whether better control or denser sampling is needed. Assume area100000m² and independent coherent survey offsets with standard uncertainty0.03m each. σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³, not independent cell error.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設面積100000m²，兩期各有獨立整面高程標準不確定度0.03m，σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³；不是逐格獨立誤差。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume area100000m² and independent coherent survey offsets with standard uncertainty0.03m each. σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³, not independent cell error.
units.verify: 用穩定地物及外部控制檢查每期共同偏差，分開報告隨機散布與高程系統分量。重算方量差的不確定度時明列相關性，若兩期共用同一偏差則不可直接套獨立平方和。~Use stable features and external control to check common offsets, reporting random scatter separately from systematic elevation components. State correlations when propagating volume uncertainty; shared bias across both epochs does not permit the same independent sum-of-squares calculation.
units.failure: 把整面偏差除以測點數平方根會虛構極高精度，使很小的地形差被誤判為侵蝕。共同控制點移動也可能讓兩次調查一起偏移而難以自行察覺。~Dividing coherent bias by the square root of point count invents precision and makes small elevation differences appear significant. Moving common control may also shift both surveys together, escaping detection within the survey network itself.
units.misconception: 增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。~Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero.
units.practice: 用穩定地物及外部控制檢查每期共同偏差，分開報告隨機散布與高程系統分量。重算方量差的不確定度時明列相關性，若兩期共用同一偏差則不可直接套獨立平方和。~Use stable features and external control to check common offsets, reporting random scatter separately from systematic elevation components. State correlations when propagating volume uncertainty; shared bias across both epochs does not permit the same independent sum-of-squares calculation.

units.anchor: 背景扣除與濁羽通量~Background correction and plume flux
units.title: 背景扣除與濁羽通量~Background correction and plume flux
units.mechanism: 濁度光學訊號不直接等於懸浮泥沙質量，需要採樣校正且區分自然背景。橫斷面通量取決於濃度與速度的共同分布，均勻完全混合只是示意；估算增量輸送量不能替代環境許可，粒徑、沉降與暴露時間仍須分別解釋。 假設均勻濃度150mg/L、背景20mg/L，增量130mg/L=0.13kg/m³，流量2m³/s，增量質量通量0.26kg/s。 ~An optical turbidity signal is not directly suspended-sediment mass; sampling calibration and background separation are required. Section flux depends jointly on concentration and velocity, with complete uniform mixing only an illustration. Estimated incremental transport does not establish environmental compliance; grading, settling and exposure duration remain separate questions. Assume uniform concentration150mg/L and background20mg/L. Increment130mg/L=0.13kg/m³; at2m³/s, incremental mass flux is0.26kg/s.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻濃度150mg/L、背景20mg/L，增量130mg/L=0.13kg/m³，流量2m³/s，增量質量通量0.26kg/s。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform concentration150mg/L and background20mg/L. Increment130mg/L=0.13kg/m³; at2m³/s, incremental mass flux is0.26kg/s.
units.verify: 同步取得背景、作業區濃度和流速，檢查背景點是否真的位於影響區外。以分層樣本辨識垂向差異，記錄光學校正式及適用粒群，將許可條件和質量計算分別比對。~Sample background, working-area concentration and velocity together, verifying that the background station lies outside the affected plume. Use depth-resolved samples to identify stratification, retain optical calibration and applicable grading, and assess permit conditions separately from mass accounting.
units.failure: 選到已受影響的背景站會低估作業增量，速度和濃度不同時取樣也可能錯配通量。儀器讀值下降可能只是粒徑改變，不一定代表輸送質量減少。~A contaminated background station understates the operational increment, and nonsynchronous concentration and velocity misstate flux. Falling optical readings may reflect changed particle size rather than a reduction in the actual mass being transported.
units.misconception: 濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。~An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration.
units.practice: 同步取得背景、作業區濃度和流速，檢查背景點是否真的位於影響區外。以分層樣本辨識垂向差異，記錄光學校正式及適用粒群，將許可條件和質量計算分別比對。~Sample background, working-area concentration and velocity together, verifying that the background station lies outside the affected plume. Use depth-resolved samples to identify stratification, retain optical calibration and applicable grading, and assess permit conditions separately from mass accounting.

units.anchor: 沉降與水平輸運~Settling and horizontal advection
units.title: 沉降與水平輸運~Settling and horizontal advection
units.mechanism: 粒子沉降與水流搬運的競爭影響落砂區，但真實濁羽還有紊流、絮凝和再懸浮。固定沉速及水平流速模型能建立時間與距離量級，不能將單一結果當成影響邊界；初始釋放深度和海床起伏也需與模型坐標一致。 假設距床3m、沉速0.02m/s、水平流0.30m/s，t=h/ws=150s，x=Ut=45m；忽略紊流與再懸浮。 ~Competition between settling and advection influences deposition, but real plumes also experience turbulence, flocculation and resuspension. Constant settling and current velocities provide time and distance scales, not a definitive impact boundary. Release depth and bed relief must also be consistent with the coordinates used by the simplified model. Assume height above bed3m, settling speed0.02m/s and horizontal current0.30m/s. t=150s and x=45m, excluding turbulence and resuspension.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設距床3m、沉速0.02m/s、水平流0.30m/s，t=h/ws=150s，x=Ut=45m；忽略紊流與再懸浮。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume height above bed3m, settling speed0.02m/s and horizontal current0.30m/s. t=150s and x=45m, excluding turbulence and resuspension.
units.verify: 以沉降柱試驗辨識不同粒群的速度範圍，核對現地潮流轉向及釋放深度。將最簡單軌跡與實測沉積分布比較，保留偏離方向作為混合或再懸浮的證據。~Use settling-column tests to identify velocity ranges for different fractions and check current reversals and release depth. Compare the simplest trajectory with observed deposition, retaining the direction of mismatch as evidence of mixing or resuspension.
units.failure: 用中值砂粒沉速代表細料會把擴散範圍算得過短，忽略潮流反轉又會放錯沉積方向。沉到床面也不保證永久固定，後續波浪可能重新輸送。~Using median-sand settling speed for fines understates plume extent, while ignoring tidal reversal misplaces deposition. Reaching the bed does not establish permanent retention because later waves can mobilize and transport the same material again.
units.misconception: 粒子第一次碰到海床後就永遠不會再進入水體輸運。~Once a particle first reaches the bed, it can never be transported again.
units.practice: 以沉降柱試驗辨識不同粒群的速度範圍，核對現地潮流轉向及釋放深度。將最簡單軌跡與實測沉積分布比較，保留偏離方向作為混合或再懸浮的證據。~Use settling-column tests to identify velocity ranges for different fractions and check current reversals and release depth. Compare the simplest trajectory with observed deposition, retaining the direction of mismatch as evidence of mixing or resuspension.

title: 海岸養灘工程~Beach nourishment
summary: 以泥沙守恆與監測辨識養灘的短期重塑和長期功能。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Distinguish nourishment reshaping and long-term function through sediment accounting and monitoring. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 養灘的發展不只在搬進更多砂，也在於追蹤砂如何沿岸與跨岸再分布。英國官方記錄海灘管理手冊更新計畫於二〇〇七年開始、二〇一一年完成，重視維護及績效；網頁後來發布的年份不等於手冊完成年份。荷蘭主管機關確認沙引擎於二〇一一年施工，利用自然作用逐步搬運材料。二〇一三年錫爾迪金調查則展示博斯等海岸的連續剖面監測，提醒單一季節不足以代表長期趨勢。本課以這些文件建立觀測觀念，所有砂量、粒徑與速度算例均為原創假設，不聲稱重現專案績效。~Nourishment development concerns tracking cross-shore and alongshore redistribution as well as delivering sand. The UK authority records a manual-update project beginning in2007 and completing in2011, with maintenance and performance emphasized; the later webpage publication date is not the manual-completion date. The Dutch owner confirms construction of the Sand Motor in2011 using natural redistribution. The2013 Ceredigion survey illustrates repeated profiles at Borth and other beaches, warning against equating one season with a long-term trend. These sources establish observational context; every volume, size and velocity calculation here is synthetic rather than a reproduction of project performance.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。假設增寬由20改為22m而長度、厚度不變，方量30000增至33000m³，增加10%；並不代表養灘維持時間增加10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design. Increasing added width from20 to22m at fixed length and thickness raises volume from30000 to33000m³ by10%, without implying10% longer retention. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume bulk volume10000m³, porosity0.40 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume borrow D50=0.45mm and native D50=0.30mm. Their ratio is1.50; this alone establishes neither grading compatibility nor retention.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設V=30000m³、沿岸長1000m、閉合深5m、陸側高2m，Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m；只限平行平移。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume V=30000m³, length1000m, closure depth5m and berm elevation2m. Parallel translation Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固體體積18000m³保持不變，孔隙率0.40時鬆方30000m³，降到0.35後V=18000/0.65=27692.3m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unchanged solid volume18000m³. Bulk volume is30000m³ at porosity0.40 and27692.3m³ at porosity0.35, using V=Vs/(1−n).
